incident: BazarLoader to Conti ransomware in 32 hours

sources.title: BazarLoader to Conti Ransomware in 32 Hours - The DFIR Report (2021-09-13)
sources.what_it_gave: entry (likely zipped JS email -> BazarLoader via rundll32), hops (SMB copy + WMIC on DC and servers, CS via services, RDP between servers), cred access (pass-the-hash, LSASS dumped on remote systems), exfil (WinSCP from file server to Romania VPS), impact (Conti domain-wide over SMB), 32h

narrative_before: In this 2021 intrusion the DFIR Report observed a BazarLoader DLL run via rundll32 on a beachhead host (initial delivery not observed, assessed zipped JavaScript email). Discovery ran ~20 minutes in, a Cobalt Strike beacon ~1 hour in, and first lateral movement around 2.5 hours in. The actors copied executables over SMB and ran them remotely with WMIC (e.g. wmic /node:"DOMAINCONTROLLER" process call create); the domain controller ran an encoded PowerShell disk-space check and Get-NetComputer and was used for further movement, and both the DC and the file server connected to Tor. Pass-the-hash was used repeatedly and LSASS was dumped on remote systems across the domain. WinSCP 5.19.1 was installed on the file server and used to exfiltrate over SCP/22 to a Romania VPS (31.14.40.160). test.exe was run via WMI on several endpoints as a test, then a renamed backup.exe (Conti) was dropped on two servers and run manually over RDP; Conti mounts remote C$ drives and encrypts over SMB. Time to ransom was just shy of 32 hours.

detection_moments.description: BazarLoader DLL running via rundll32 on the beachhead; discovery ~20 min in, Cobalt Strike beacon ~1h in.
detection_moments.evidence: 'BazarLoader ran here, followed by discovery and a Cobalt Strike beacon ... Execution was via rundll32' - BazarLoader to Conti in 32 Hours, The DFIR Report

detection_moments.description: ~2.5h: first lateral movement - SMB copy + WMIC exec on the domain controller; pass-the-hash; LSASS dumped on remote systems; file server set up for exfil.
detection_moments.evidence: 'copying executables over SMB, then running them remotely with WMIC ... dump lsass memory for further credentials ... WinSCP 5.19.1, downloaded and installed on the file server' - BazarLoader to Conti in 32 Hours

detection_moments.description: ~31-32h: test.exe run via WMI on endpoints, then renamed backup.exe (Conti) dropped on two servers and run over RDP; Conti encrypts over SMB mounting remote C$.
detection_moments.evidence: 'test.exe was run via WMI on several endpoints first ... a renamed backup.exe was dropped on two servers and run manually over RDP ... mounts all remote C$ drives in the local network and encrypts over SMB' - BazarLoader to Conti in 32 Hours
